alt: 志工蹲著刷洗地面、收拾餐具，旁人皺眉指著污漬催促，他仍耐心工作。
scene_prompt: After a busy community picnic, a volunteer patiently kneels to scrub a muddy floor and gathers heavy dishes. One nearby impatient adult complains with a frown and pointed finger at a remaining dirty spot, while another gestures impatiently toward more dishes. The volunteer remains steady, kind and responsible and keeps cleaning. Clear work plus unfair grumbling, no speech bubbles.
